summary: Design reliable pipelines and ML-ready datasets with Python, Spark, Kafka, and Airflow. Review practical course outcomes and enrol.
lede: Applied data engineering helps data, analytics, and ML engineers build reliable pipelines and datasets for analytics and model workflows. Using Python and SQL with Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, and Apache Airflow, participants practise defining data contracts, handling schema changes and late records, and planning retries and backfills. They also develop skills in checking data quality, tracing dataset lineage, and assessing readiness for model training or inference.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who build or depend on data pipelines and need to improve how those systems handle change, failure, and downstream machine-learning requirements. It suits professionals with working Python and SQL knowledge.
prerequisites: Prior experience writing basic Python and SQL queries, and familiarity with relational tables and common data formats such as JSON or Parquet. Coding is required for the exercises. Advanced distributed-processing and ML system concepts receive operational or conceptual treatment; production deployment is outside the course scope.
